jane (customer): Hey team — after adding the SDK via Poetry I hit an ImportError when starting my app. I ran `poetry add redwood-sdk[async]` and it installed, but `from redwood import Client` fails with a httpx import error. Traceback:
```
ImportError: cannot import name 'AsyncClient' from 'httpx' (/Users/jane/.venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/httpx/__init__.py)
```
Python 3.10.6, Poetry 1.5.1 on macOS (arm64). Any quick ideas?

alice (support): sorry you hit this — can you paste `poetry show --tree` or `poetry export -f requirements.txt --dev` so we can see resolved httpx version? also `pip list` or `poetry run python -c "import httpx; print(httpx.__version__)"` would help. :mag:

jane (customer): posting minimal output, here's `poetry show --tree` snippet:
```
redwood-sdk 0.3.1
├── httpx 0.21.1
├── protobuf 4.23.0
└── other-lib 0.4.2 -> pulls httpx 0.21.1
```
and `poetry run python -c "import httpx; print(httpx.__version__)"` prints `0.21.1`.

ben (devex): thanks. this looks like an httpx mismatch — our async helpers expect httpx >=0.23 (AsyncClient surface changed a bit). 0.21.x can cause that ImportError or a missing symbol. Two quick workarounds:
1) `poetry add "httpx>=0.23.0"` to force a newer httpx in your lockfile (preferred)
2) create a fresh venv and `pip install redwood-sdk[async]` to let pip resolve a compatible httpx if you don't need the other dependency pinned.

jane (customer): ok trying `poetry add "httpx>=0.23.0"` now...

jane (customer): ✅ that fixed it. app starts, import error gone. thanks! :tada:

alice (support): great. leaving notes here for records — appears `other-lib` pulled in httpx 0.21 via its own constraints and Poetry kept that. we'll escalate to engineering to loosen our SDK constraint to avoid hard breakage.

carlos (eng): assigned to me. we'll publish a patch that relaxes the sdk extras constraint so it doesn't require a narrow httpx range that conflicts with common dependency graphs. plan: cut 0.3.2 with "httpx>=0.23,<1.0" and bump release today. also adding a short troubleshooting blurb to support docs about overriding httpx in pyproject when consumers hit this.

deploy-bot: deploy started for redwood-sdk v0.3.2 -> npm/pypi (publishing pypi wheel). :rocket:

carlos (eng): patch published and release notes posted. CT tickets: SDK-348. jane, let us know if you hit anything else and sorry for the friction.

jane (customer): thanks everyone, workaround + release both good for me. closing the loop. :)
